slides.title: It's a hinge, not a squat.
slides.body: Hips back, shins nearly vertical. Think fast deadlift, not a squat with a bell attached.

slides.title: Hike it like a football.
slides.body: Let the bell travel high between your thighs. Wait for it, then hinge late and fast.

slides.title: Stand up hard.
slides.body: Hips through, glutes squeezed. The bell floats because you stood up, not because you lifted it.

slides.title: Your arms are ropes.
slides.body: If your shoulders burn by rep 15, they're doing the job your hips skipped.

slides.title: Tall, not leaning back.
slides.body: Ribs down, glutes on, one straight line. Leaning back adds zero height.
